notes.title: Version 2
notes.notes:
[h1]Realm of Heroes - Version 2 is Available Now[/h1]

[list]
[*] Play the game as a Historical Leader.
Choose a Leader for you and the computer players from 12 historical leader images.
Also, make new leaders from the historical leader image using your name.

[*] Three skill levels for the computer: Novice, Skilled and Expert. 
Novice: Doesn't always make the best move.  Start playing against 3 Computer - Novice players to learn the game.
Skilled: Should be able to win against a Skilled computer player but it is not easy.
Expert: Very hard to win against 3 Computer - Expert players.

[*] Track the Highest Score for both Winning and Loosing.
It is not enough to win the game.  Try to achieve the highest score.

[*] Expanded Book of Knowledge to include more topics and descriptions.
Question mark (?) on the Title Panel allows direct access to the panel's how-to-use description.
[/list]
